text:
Maya: FYI enabling the new FP8 kernel on L40s canary caused a small but repeatable accuracy drift on the conversational eval suite. logs attached inline. :thinking:

Arjun: how small are we talking? dev or canary only? :eyes:

Maya: canary only, traffic mirrored from prod. Perplexity up ~2.4% on long-turn tests (seq>1024). short seqs unaffected. stack traces show occasional activation saturations and some NaN falls in the scaled softmax path. snippet:
```
[2026-03-18 14:02:13] WARN fp8_runtime: activation_scale exceeded threshold (1.12)
[2026-03-18 14:02:13] ERROR kv_cache: tile_index out_of_bounds (tile=256, max=254)
```

Sanjay: sounds like a tiling + prefix cache mismatch. L40s kernel chooses smaller tiles for perf; if we stack mixed-precision layers with legacy kv tiling it can overflow the buffer. Did you enable mixed-precision stacking?

Maya: yes, we flipped `enable_fp8_mixed_stack=true` in the canary config to get perf parity with H100. H100 didn't show the drift.

Arjun: H100 and L40s have different tiling/warp heuristics. Two immediate suspects: (1) activation re-scaling heuristic (fp8 dynamic alpha), (2) kv cache tile alignment. Try forcing `--tiling-align=256` or `--kv-tile-check=on` in the runtime. Also check if the kernel falls back to INT8 for certain matmuls.

Olivia: ran a short eval with canary flags Arjun suggested:
```
cmd: ./run_eval --model rdlw-chat-3b --seq 2048 --fp8 1 --tiling-align 256 --repro 5
results: ppl: base=12.4 -> fp8-stack=12.8 (3.2% worse)
notes: NaN counters dropped to 0 when kv-tile-check=on
```

RuntimeBot: deploy/canary/rdlw-chat-3b: rolling canary updated by maya. commit: a7d9f2. Canary traffic: 3%

Sanjay: if NaNs go away with kv-tile-check then it's probably a buffer index math bug when tile sizes differ between layers. We should add a runtime guard that recomputes tile offsets at layer transitions (cheap check). I'll sketch a hotfix.

Arjun: also add a small randomized input batch test that fuzzes sequence lengths 1..4096 and checks kv bounds before enabling the kernel auto-switch. We had a similar bug for fp16->fp8 transitions on H100 last year.

Maya: good plan. For immediate mitigation: will disable `enable_fp8_mixed_stack` on L40s canary and keep H100 enabled. will run a longer 24h eval for regression numbers.

Olivia: one more datapoint: AWQ/GPTQ quantized variants don't show the same drift — this is strictly an execution pattern problem, not model weights. so we can use routing policy to prefer AWQ when seq>1024 on L40s until fix.

Maya: assigning followups:
- Sanjay: prototype runtime guard and a minimal repro harness (deadline EOD)
- Arjun: add fuzzing test + canary config to block auto-enable until green
- Olivia: run 24h eval and post full diffs

Maya: tagging @Sanjay @Arjun @Olivia. will post results when the 24h run finishes. :thumbsup:
